FilePatch.title: FilePatch

FolderPatch.description:
Omitted = unchanged; an explicit `parent_id: null` = move to the root.
`model_fields_set` is what tells those two apart.
FolderPatch.title: FolderPatch

InvoiceFields.description:
What a person confirms: the same shape validates a queued invoice and
creates a manual one. Total and due date are what the reminders and the
chart need, so they are required.
InvoiceFields.title: InvoiceFields

get.description:
Without q/tag: one folder (absent = root). With either: every live file
of the caller's, wherever it is -- the SPA shows a Location column then.

schema.title: Response List Files Api Files Get

delete.description:
Soft: the row is marked, the bytes stay. From the outside this is what
today's delete already looks like -- the bucket is versioned, so even the
old hard delete only ever wrote a delete marker. The Trash that makes the
difference visible is Phase 3.

patch.description:
Rename, describe, retag and move in one call. Metadata only: no storage
call, because the object key is the id.

schema.title: Response List Folders Api Folders Get

delete.description:
BR-7: soft, and a non-empty folder needs `?recursive=true`. The 409
carries the subtree's counts so the SPA can ask before retrying.

schema.title: Response List Invoices Api Invoices Get

post.description:
One invoice per PDF. A preselected service (or provider, when the drop
comes from a provider's page) narrows what the AI may propose.

schema.title: Response Upload Invoices Api Invoices Post

delete.description: The invoice goes; its PDF stays in the uploader's Files.

get.description:
The PDF lives in the uploader's files, which other members cannot read
through /api/files; this endpoint is the household's way to it.
